reached_sql:
SELECT 
    t_s_secyear.customer_id,
    t_s_secyear.customer_first_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_last_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_email_address
FROM 
    store_sales_1998 t_s_firstyear
JOIN 
    web_sales_1998 t_w_firstyear ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id AND t_s_firstyear.max_dyear = 1998 AND t_w_firstyear.max_dyear = 1998
JOIN 
    store_sales_1999 t_s_secyear ON t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id AND t_s_secyear.max_dyear = 1999
JOIN 
    web_sales_1999 t_w_secyear ON t_w_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id AND t_w_secyear.max_dyear = 1999
WHERE 
    t_s_secyear.avg_store_sales > t_s_firstyear.avg_store_sales
    AND t_w_secyear.avg_web_sales > t_w_firstyear.avg_web_sales
ORDER BY 
    t_s_secyear.customer_id,
    t_s_secyear.customer_first_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_last_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
